query: I have an 87-year-old female. Among females 82–92, what is the 25th percentile of distinct cardiac procedures per hospitalization?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY num_procedures) AS percentile FROM relevant_procedures;
